# Guarded build 2247 publisher

Separate tooling-only controller on production build 2246. Never merge it into main. Only explicitly allowlisted publishing code, plan, prior archive and bounded Recovery parts may differ from the production baseline. Application source remains the independently validated PR #336 candidate/tree.

Reuse the established actor/ref-bound Actions GITHUB_TOKEN with contents:write for prepare → expected-head application squash → same-controller publish. Require all thirteen hosted jobs, fifteen source-pinned original archives, both complete local/hosted ten-gate results and full checksum manifests. Every existing resource, source, history, workflow, protection and immutable-byte guard remains required. New guards require both league shapes, four viewports, exact capital movement snapshots and execution of all fourteen added regression controls.

Preserve every local canonical manifest member unchanged. If the full Recovery exceeds GitHub's per-file Git limit, commit it as ordered parts, each at most 64 MiB and at most four parts. Verify each path, type, size and SHA256; reconstruct inside the Actions scratch directory, verify the complete archive SHA256/CRC and run the unchanged canonical/native guards before uploading the single full release attachment. Reject missing, changed, duplicate, reordered or symlinked parts. No archive member is omitted, no new access method is introduced, and no application validation or authentication is bypassed.

The unfinalized plan cannot publish. Finalization must pin exact source, version/build, draft, runs/artifacts, actual test and manifest populations, Recovery/prior hashes and part hashes. Prepare reads every attachment back before application merge; publish requires the approved PR merged at current main with the identical validated tree and verifies immutable release/deployment identity. Preserve failed and incomplete attempts separately. Canonical validation steps match the application candidate.
